seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: Primary: McClintock 109,088 votes (61.6%), Masuda 42,559 (24%) per Rafu Shimpo; NBC showed 61.3% and 24.3%. McClintock's UCLA B.A. year is 1978 per the bioguide search summary, but a LittleSis mirror shows 1988, likely a transcription error. One summary said the 2014 Congressional Directory gives his State Senate years as 2000-04, against 2000-2008 in the bioguide; verify. His birthplace (Bronxville, N.Y.) was seen only on a LittleSis mirror of the bioguide and is omitted. Masuda: in a Turlock Journal interview he said he was born in Green Bay, Wisc., and grew up in Amador County; that is a news source, so it is omitted from facts. No primary source was found for his State Department tenure or degree.
